newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent jumps to session high as U.S. rebounds.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent jumps to session high as U.S. rebounds.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures on Monday jumped up to a new session high after early falls, tracking NYMEX crude which also rebounded after earlier losses, brokers said.
March Brent was 29 cents up at $22.83 a barrel at 1633 GMT, having hit an intra-day high of $22.91.
"The U.S. is reacting like London this morning and came off too quickly early on (then bounced back)," said one broker.
Traders said there was a lot of uncertainty and nervousness in the market. "There's very little interest out there, it's very quiet, very thin, very nervous," one said.
Despite the gains, some brokers said they still saw falls towards and even below the $22 level this week.

"I do see it falling below $22 this week, if not tomorrow - $21.08 is the target," one broker said. "Everyone is saying the cold spell is finished in the States and we could see a sell-off on the back of that," he added.
February gas oil was trading $3.50 down at $212.25 a tonne.
Traders attributed the fall to warmer weather in Europe subduing physical demand, which weighed on futures.
